settings.heading: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Last updated: May 2026 — a starting template, review before launch.

Shipping

Free shipping on orders over $50 within the continental US. Orders under $50 ship at a flat $4.95. Most orders are processed within 1–2 business days.

  • Standard (US): 3–5 business days
  • Expedited (US): 1–2 business days
  • International: 7–14 business days; duties may apply

You'll receive tracking by email as soon as your order ships.

Returns

Every order is backed by our 90-day money-back promise. Not satisfied? Email hello@lisse.com within 90 days for a full refund — keep the bottle. Unopened multi-packs can be returned within 30 days.

Damaged orders

If anything arrives damaged, email us within 14 days with a photo and we'll make it right.
